def remove_item(self, sku: str, qty: int | None = None) -> None:
    if sku not in self._items:
        raise KeyError(sku)
    if qty is None:
        del self._items[sku]
        return
    if isinstance(qty, bool) or not isinstance(qty, int):

    current = self._items[sku][1]
    if qty < 1 or qty > current:
        raise ValueError("qty must be between 1 and current quantity")
    remaining = current - qty

        del self._items[sku]
    else:

    }
